page: Microsoft Azure EC32es_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECEV6 server family. It is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external volumes. It is designed to be Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance block storage options. The instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or graphics processing units.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC32es_v6 offers a high memory density relative to its compute allocation, making it a viable option for workloads that require substantial RAM without the overhead of local disk management. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems, and large-scale data processing tasks that leverage external storage architectures.
